title: 第四章 疯批狠人
novel_title: 纨绔女修四处撩，绿茶狼崽黑化了
content_zh:
025操纵着十几只小蜜蜂，差点累劈叉。它提着劲儿，把小蜜蜂扔去苍岚住处后，就进入休眠模式了。

    萧姚快速浏览了大典各个角度的监控画面，把颜值在八分以上的人员一一截图，整理打包，单方面丢给不省人事的025。

    压榨系统，萧姚做得轻车熟路。

    再看看又过去一天的倒计时，给系统派活、倒反天罡的萧姚，就更没有心理压力了。

    双方目标一致，谁都别想清闲！

    结束了大典内部人员的基础摸底，萧姚拍了拍自己的双颊，深吸一口气，打起精神正襟危坐，点开了独属苍岚的监控画面。

    小蜜蜂所在的位置有些刁钻，视角拉出了又高又远的大斜角，萧姚只能窥探到苍岚的动作姿态，脸上的神情却是模糊不清的。

    萧姚忍不住眯起眼，往前伸直了脖子，恨不得整个人趴进去。

    苍岚手中还拿着萧姚白天给他的药膏，一动不动，似乎在出神。

    萧姚从刚开始的双眼紧盯画面，到注意力涣散想打哈欠。

    原因无他，苍岚保持同一个姿势，保持了快一个小时！

    萧姚嘴角微抽。

    到底是这人太能忍，还是她的监控卡了……

    萧姚有些焦躁地曲起指节，敲了敲桌面，连自己都有点拿不准这种情况算不算异常。

    时间一分一秒的过去，眼看倒计时又跳下去一个小时，萧姚终于决定转换目标。

    在切断画面的瞬间，萧姚的余光仿佛捕捉到了苍岚的异动……

    萧姚定睛想细看，监控画面却消散在空中，她连忙手忙脚乱地重新打开小蜜蜂的监控画面。

    短短几秒的功夫，整个画面的色调都变了！

    明明还是昏黄的空间，阴暗的底色，可偏偏在画面最中心，出现了刺眼的鲜红！

    药膏滚落在地上，苍岚低垂着头，抱膝坐在地上，尾巴盘在脚侧。

    原本已经结痂的尾尖，好似又被生生撕裂，开始不停出血，片刻功夫就汇了一小汪。

    萧姚只觉得自己屁股一疼。

    眨眼的功夫，他就又伤上加伤，现场也没有任何厮打的痕迹，那么就只有一种可能。

    苍岚，他在亲手自伤！

    萧姚汗毛直立。

    嘶！

    表面看起来又茶又奶，结果背地里是这种疯批狠人！！！

    这么看来，没准……苍岚还真就是反派本派……

    一时之间，萧姚内心五味杂陈，被兽耳毛茸茸迷惑的心如坠冰窟。

    对自己都能下这种狠手，那嘎起她来，岂不是更干脆？

    萧姚一脸麻木地关掉监控，往床上一躺，盯着屋顶发呆。

    所以，明天她到底要用什么身份什么态度，去面对反派嫌疑人苍岚啊？

    ……
content_en:
025 controlled a dozen little bees and almost did the splits due to fatigue. It worked hard, threw the little bee to Cang Lan's residence, and then entered sleep mode.

    Xiao Yao quickly browsed the surveillance footage from all angles of the ceremony, took screenshots of the people with an appearance above eight points one by one, sorted and packaged them, and unilaterally threw them to the unconscious 025.

    Xiao Yao is very familiar with the pressing system.

    Looking at the countdown that has passed for another day, Xiao Yao, who is assigned to work for the system and rebels against Tiangang, feels even less psychological pressure.

    Both sides have the same goal, no one can have any leisure time!

    After finishing the basic investigation of the internal staff of the ceremony, Xiao Yao patted his cheeks, took a deep breath, braced himself, sat upright, and clicked on Cang Lan's exclusive surveillance screen.

    The position of Little Bee was a little tricky, and the angle of view was at a high and far angle. Xiao Yao could only spy on Cang Lan's movements, but the expression on his face was blurry.

    Xiao Yao couldn't help but narrowed his eyes and stretched his neck forward, wishing he could lie down in it.

    Cang Lan still held the ointment Xiao Yao had given him during the day, motionless, and seemed to be in a trance.

    From the beginning, Xiao Yao's eyes were fixed on the screen, to when his concentration was distracted and he wanted to yawn.

    For no other reason, Cang Lan kept the same posture for almost an hour!

    Xiao Yao's mouth twitched slightly.

    Is it because this person is too tolerant, or is it her surveillance card...

    Xiao Yao crooked his knuckles anxiously and knocked on the table. Even he was a little unsure whether this situation was abnormal or not.

    Time passed minute by minute, and seeing the countdown jump down to another hour, Xiao Yao finally decided to change his goal.

    At the moment when the screen was cut off, Xiao Yao's peripheral vision seemed to capture Cang Lan's strange movements...

    Xiao Yao fixed her eyes and wanted to take a closer look, but the surveillance screen disappeared in the air. She hurriedly reopened the surveillance screen of Little Bee.

    In just a few seconds, the tone of the entire picture changed!

    It was obviously still a dim space with a dark background, but in the center of the picture, a dazzling bright red appeared!

    The ointment rolled to the ground. Cang Lan lowered her head and sat on the ground hugging her knees with her tail wrapped around her feet.

    The tip of the tail, which was already scabbed, seemed to be torn apart again, and it began to bleed non-stop, and a small pool formed in a matter of seconds.

    Xiao Yao only felt a pain in his butt.

    In the blink of an eye, he was injured again and again, and there were no signs of a fight at the scene, so there was only one possibility.

    Cang Lan, he is hurting himself with his own hands!

    Xiao Yao's hair stood on end.

    hiss!

    On the surface, he looks nice and sweet, but behind the scenes he is such a crazy and ruthless person! ! !

    From this point of view, maybe... Cang Lan is really the villain...

    For a moment, Xiao Yao's heart was full of mixed emotions, and his heart was as if it was falling into an ice cave as he was confused by the furry animal ears.

    If he could be so cruel to himself, wouldn't it be easier to kill her?

    Xiao Yao turned off the monitor with a numb look on his face, lay down on the bed, and stared at the roof in a daze.

    So, what identity and attitude will she use to face the suspected villain Cang Lan tomorrow?

    …
title_en: Chapter 4 Crazy criticism of ruthless people
